en.headline: Clement Cheung reappointed Insurance Authority chief for another three years
en.dek: The government confirmed the reappointment of the regulator’s longest-serving CEO, citing progress on risk-based capital, insurance-linked securities and captive insurance.
body: The government on Friday announced the reappointment of Clement Cheung Wan-ching as Chief Executive Officer of the Insurance Authority for a further three-year term from 15 August 2026 to 14 August 2029.

Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said Cheung had demonstrated strong performance in advancing Hong Kong’s position as an international risk management centre and strengthening the regulatory framework. Under his leadership the authority had progressed the risk-based capital regime, supported infrastructure investments, strengthened the insurance-linked securities market and enhanced the competitiveness of captive insurance business.

Cheung was first appointed CEO in August 2018 and is currently a member of the Executive Committee of the International Association of Insurance Supervisors and of the Asian Forum of Insurance Regulators. The Insurance Authority is an independent regulator established in 2015 that assumed full supervision of insurers in 2017 and direct regulation of intermediaries in 2019.

Hui expressed confidence that Cheung would continue to enhance prudential regulation, safeguard policyholders’ interests and work with the industry to reinforce Hong Kong’s competitiveness while exploring opportunities in the Mainland and overseas markets.

zh.headline: 保險業監管局行政總監張雲正獲續任三年
zh.dek: 政府公布張雲正由八月十五日起再任三年，財庫局局長許正宇讚揚其推動風險為本資本制度及保險相連證券市場的工作。
body: 政府周五宣布，續任張雲正為保險業監管局行政總監，任期三年，由二零二六年八月十五日至二零二九年八月十四日。
財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇表示，張雲正在推動香港作為國際風險管理中心及加強保險業監管框架方面表現卓越。在其領導下，保監局在落實風險為本資本制度、支援內地及本港基建投資、強化保險相連證券市場，以及提升專屬自保保險業務競爭力等方面取得進展。
張雲正於二零一八年八月首次獲委任為行政總監，目前為國際保險監督官協會執行委員會成員，以及亞洲保險監管論壇成員。保監局於二零一五年成立，二零一七年接管保險公司監管工作，二零一九年開始直接規管保險中介人。
許正宇表示，有信心張雲正會繼續加強審慎監管、保障保單持有人利益，並與業界合作鞏固香港競爭力，同時開拓內地及海外市場新機遇。
